title: Graded Alarm Thresholds and Emergency Triggers

CAUTION.meaning: Value is drifting away from optimal setpoints

WARNING.action_required: Act immediately to prevent critical escalation

CRITICAL.meaning: Hazardous condition; immediate danger to life or habitat integrity
CRITICAL.action_required: Execute emergency protocol (shelter, patch, shed load, abort EVA)

cabin_total_pressure_kpa.description: Total atmospheric pressure inside the pressurized lunar habitat.
cabin_total_pressure_kpa.failure_mode: Rapid decompression causes acute hypoxia, ebullism, and physiological collapse.
cabin_total_pressure_kpa.citation: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev D: Habitability and Environmental Health, Section 6.1 (Atmospheric Pressure).
cabin_total_pressure_kpa.how_nasa_does_it: Isolate the leaking module by sealing interconnecting hatch doors, then deploy high-pressure sealants or repair tape to patch the micrometeoroid breach.

cabin_o2_percentage.description: Oxygen concentration in the habitat breathing atmosphere.
cabin_o2_percentage.failure_mode: Hypoxia below 16% O2 leads to impaired judgment, dizziness, and loss of consciousness.
cabin_o2_percentage.citation: NASA Advanced Oxygen Generation Podcast & Technical Standards (14.7 psia, 21% O2).
cabin_o2_percentage.how_nasa_does_it: Command the Oxygen Generation Assembly (OGA) to maximum electrolysis output and vent nitrogen balance gas to maintain partial pressure.

cabin_co2_partial_pressure_mmhg.description: Partial pressure of carbon dioxide in the habitat atmosphere.
cabin_co2_partial_pressure_mmhg.failure_mode: Excess CO2 causes severe headaches, lethargy, cognitive impairment, and acidosis (hypercapnia).
cabin_co2_partial_pressure_mmhg.citation: Law, J. et al. (2015). Spacecraft Maximum Allowable Concentrations (SMAC) for Carbon Dioxide. NASA NTRS 20150021777.
cabin_co2_partial_pressure_mmhg.how_nasa_does_it: Activate redundant Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly (CDRA) beds or deploy lithium hydroxide (LiOH) emergency canisters to scrub excess CO2.

cabin_temperature_celsius.description: Internal ambient temperature maintained by Active Thermal Control System (ATCS).
cabin_temperature_celsius.failure_mode: Hypothermia during lunar night or heat exhaustion during peak solar irradiation.
cabin_temperature_celsius.citation: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev D, Thermal Environment Standards.
cabin_temperature_celsius.how_nasa_does_it: Adjust ammonia/water coolant loop bypass valves and deploy deployable heat rejection radiators.

cumulative_radiation_dose_msv.description: Total cumulative ionizing radiation absorbed dose across mission lifetime.
cumulative_radiation_dose_msv.failure_mode: Acute radiation sickness at short bursts (>500 mSv) or elevated lifetime risk of radiation-induced cancer beyond 600 mSv.
cumulative_radiation_dose_msv.citation: NASA Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) FAQ & OCHMO Technical Brief: Permissible Exposure Limits (600 mSv career limit).
cumulative_radiation_dose_msv.how_nasa_does_it: Direct all crew members into the heavily shielded central storm shelter (compacted regolith and polyethylene water walls) during Solar Particle Events.

eva_suit_oxygen_minutes_left.description: Remaining oxygen supply in the Portable Life Support System (PLSS) backpack during a spacewalk.
eva_suit_oxygen_minutes_left.failure_mode: Asphyxiation on the lunar surface once primary and secondary O2 reservoirs are exhausted.
eva_suit_oxygen_minutes_left.citation: NASA STEM Activity: Artemis Generation Spacesuits (7-hour mission rule, 30-minute reserve rule).
eva_suit_oxygen_minutes_left.how_nasa_does_it: Mission Flight Rules mandate that an EVA team must immediately abort and ingress the airlock if consumable margins fall below 30 minutes travel time.
